cultivation_breakthrough_attempt.title: On the Cusp of Enlightenment
cultivation_breakthrough_attempt.description: [initiator_name] senses their internal energy reaching a critical juncture. A breakthrough may be at hand — or a dangerous Qi Deviation.

opt_push_through.text: Push through the barrier. Risk everything for glory.

effects.text: I pushed my Qi to the limit. The outcome will reveal itself soon.

opt_meditate.text: Retreat into seclusion. Let the breakthrough come naturally.

effects.text: I entered seclusion to guide my Qi carefully.

cultivation_result_safe.title: A Steady Advance
cultivation_result_safe.description: [initiator_name] emerges from seclusion with a clearer mind and stronger meridians. The Dao rewards patience.

effects.text: My patient cultivation has borne fruit.

cultivation_result_risky.title: The Edge of the Abyss
cultivation_result_risky.description: [initiator_name]'s gamble with their Qi bears consequences. The channels burn...

effects.text: The breakthrough was agonizing, but I endured.

opt_fail.text: The Qi spirals out of control.

effects.text: I suffered a Qi Deviation. My foundation is damaged.

personal_existential_doubt.title: The Void Between Breaths
personal_existential_doubt.description: [initiator_name] finds themselves unable to enter meditation. For three days they have sat unmoving, confronting an emptiness they cannot name.

opt_seek_master.text: Seek guidance from a senior cultivator.

effects.text: I sought a senior's guidance through my spiritual crisis.

opt_endure.text: Endure alone. The Dao tests those it favors.

effects.text: I sat with the emptiness alone until it passed. The Dao tests those it favors.

meridian_injury_seclusion.title: Cracked Meridians
meridian_injury_seclusion.description: [initiator_name] has been quietly nursing cracked meridians from a recent battle or cultivation accident. Left unaddressed, permanent damage is possible.

effects.text: I entered healing seclusion. Slow recovery is better than none.

opt_ignore.text: Train through the pain. Weakness is temporary.

effects.text: I trained through my injuries. The pain is my teacher.
